Sonreal's "Everywhere We Go" — original release 2014. Aaron Hoffman (born August 16, 1985), better known by his stage name SonReal, is an independent Canadian singer, rapper and songwriter.

Artist: SonReal · Title: Everywhere We Go · Album: For The Town EP · Year: 2015 · Genre: Hip Hop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2010's/SonReal - Everywhere We Go.mp4.

Musical career


2006–2012: Early Career and mixtapes
SonReal began his career in 2006 with the release of "Trapped in the Streets" (2006), followed by a series of mixtapes he recorded while living in Vancouver, BC.

These included: Good Morning (2008), The Stroll (2009),The Lightyear Mixtape (2010), Where's Waldo (2010), Words I Said (2012), Good News (2012), and One Long Day (2014).
